arguments.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our system wrongly filed it as a fridge problem, so please ignore the fridge questions. We have corrected it to a door repair and are treating it as urgent. Until it is looked at, please don't slam the door, as the glass could break. Close it gently and keep clear of the glass. A few quick questions: 1) Does the front door lock securely when you leave or go to bed? 2) Is any glass cracked or loose? 3) Which days and times suit access, and are there any pets or alarms we should know about? We are asking the landlord to approve a contractor and will update you by tomorrow.

arguments.body: Hello, thanks for reporting this. Sorry, our system wrongly filed it as a fridge problem, so please ignore the fridge questions. We have corrected it to a door repair and are treating it as urgent. Until it is looked at, please don't slam the door, as the glass could break. Close it gently and keep clear of the glass. A few quick questions: 1) Does the front door lock securely when you leave or go to bed? 2) Is any glass cracked or loose? 3) Which days and times suit access, and are there any pets or alarms we should know about? We are asking the landlord to approve a contractor and will update you by tomorrow.
